media.title: Frank Lloyd with his Best Director award, April 1930
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the film director Frank Lloyd in evening dress, holding an Academy Award statuette.
media.publicCaption: Frank Lloyd at the second Academy Awards ceremony on 3 April 1930, holding the Best Director award for The Divine Lady. Five years later he directed Mutiny on the Bounty, the one film of his in this archive, for which Kaper wrote Love Song of Tahiti with Walter Jurmann and Gus Kahn.
media.publicCreditLine: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, 3 April 1930; via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States. The photograph was published in 1930, so its ninety-five-year term expired on 1 January 2026; no question of renewal arises and the URAA does not apply to a United States work. The Wikimedia Commons file carries the PD-US-expired tag on the same reasoning.
